canonicalSource.rule: Treat every production .vtube.json as immutable lineage source before derived assets.

queens.rule: Queens stores observations and evidence; it is not automatically a good template.

promotionCriteria: reusable across at least one new topic or project
failure pattern excluded from positive seed

templates.t2: APP_ID/platform-specific persona, camera, TTS, subtitle, thumbnail, CTA, duration, aspect-ratio and publish package.

imageLineage.rule: Embedded characterImage/base64 remains traceable to source JSON; externalize to Drive only when reuse/edit/runtime requires a standalone asset.

apiTeacherPhase.goal: Measure API-vs-internal deltas, store successful methods as JSON/Seed/Templates, then move repeatable work to local/Drive/Apps Script/GitHub logic.
apiTeacherPhase.steadyState: API gap/fallback only after parity verification; no front API keys.

feedbackLoop.success: Store input, method, output, QA score, lineage and reusable guardrail; promote if criteria pass.
feedbackLoop.failure: Store failed stage, root cause, wrong assumption, failed approach, minimal fix and retest evidence; never promote failed behavior as a positive Seed.
feedbackLoop.retest: Same-condition x2 after a state-changing fix.

series.rule: Series continuation reuses verified seeds and records episode-to-episode continuity deltas.
